title: Row operations around a model's blocks: head clips, small products, sink-gated outputs, scaled adds, summary mixes, gated joins with low-rank gates and span attention, one Triton launch a call (two where a reduction spans programs)

head-clip.what: each head vector of a token (times a learned scale) shortened to an L2 length, then times a per-token factor: one program a token head, BD = the head width rounded up to a power of two

WARPS.what: warps a program (its reductions' layout: the shape's alone)

yardstick.library: torch on the same rows: the model technique's own torch form (its CUDA fallback), a chain of elementwise kernels

small-product.what: each row's R values (rounded to BF16) times a small FP32 matrix [R][E], summed in index order and rounded to BF16: a program a row and BLOCK of the E outputs

yardstick.library: torch.matmul of the BF16-rounded rows and the matrix in FP32 (cuBLAS), rounded to BF16

sink-gate.what: an attention's rows times sigmoid(lse - sink) (a sink logit with no value) and a sigmoid output gate, BF16 out: one program a token head

yardstick.library: torch on the same rows: the model technique's own torch form (its CUDA fallback), a chain of elementwise kernels

scaled-add.what: (y + x) * scale over every value, elementwise: BLOCK values a program

yardstick.library: torch on the same rows: the model technique's own torch form (its CUDA fallback), a chain of elementwise kernels

summary-mix.what: softmax attention of learned queries over a token's normed summary rows and its own row: two launches over (token, CHUNK of the hidden values), the chunks' partial sums of squares and dot products, then each chunk's output from their sum in chunk order

CHUNK.what: hidden values a program: the partials' chunk, so a token's sums follow it

WARPS.what: warps a program (its reductions' layout: the shape's alone)

yardstick.library: torch on the same rows: the model technique's own torch form (its CUDA fallback), a chain of elementwise kernels

pair-norm.what: [rms(x), rms(m)] of two rows in BF16, each without a weight: one program a row, its sums of squares in BLOCK lanes

BLOCK.what: lanes the sums of squares accumulate

WARPS.what: warps a program (its reductions' layout: the shape's alone)

yardstick.library: torch on the same rows: the model technique's own torch form (its CUDA fallback), a chain of elementwise kernels

gated-join.what: (1 - tanh(f)) * x + tanh(a) * m over every value of a row: a program a row and BLOCK of its values

yardstick.library: torch on the same rows: the model technique's own torch form (its CUDA fallback), a chain of elementwise kernels

low-rank-gates.what: several gated joins of a row at once with their low-rank gate products inside: the gate rows g = down . [rms(x), rms(m)] (BR rank rows a program, the inputs in BK lanes), then f, a = up . g and the join (BH hidden values a program)

BR.what: rank rows a program of the down product

BK.what: input lanes the down product's sums accumulate

BH.what: hidden values a program of the up product

WARPS.what: warps a program (its reductions' layout: the shape's alone)

yardstick.library: the same joins as pair_norm, two matmuls (cuBLAS) and gated_join

span-attention.what: each row's queries over a span of its cached positions, no causal mask: programs (row's KV head, CHUNK positions) with an online softmax in steps of BN keys, then the splits merged in split order

BN.what: keys a step of the online softmax

WARPS.what: warps a program (its reductions' layout: the shape's alone)

yardstick.library: torch scaled_dot_product_attention with the span's mask over the same rows
